# Get-ZbxContext

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the session's connections and the current one.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxContext [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxContext cmdlet writes the runspace's Zabbix context: every connection Connect-ZbxServer added, by name, and the current one, which commands use when no -Connection is given. Each runspace has its own context, so a job or a ForEach-Object -Parallel branch starts with no connection. The command sends nothing to a server.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Show the current connection

```powershell
(Get-ZbxContext).Current | Select-Object Name, Endpoint, ApiVersion
```

Current is the connection commands use by default; Connect-ZbxServer -NoDefault adds one without making it current.

### Example 2: List every connection of the session

```powershell
(Get-ZbxContext).Servers.Values | Select-Object Name, Endpoint
```

Servers holds every connection by its name; Disconnect-ZbxServer removes one.

## PARAMETERS

### CommonParameters

This command supports the common parameters: `-Debug`, `-ErrorAction`, `-ErrorVariable`, `-InformationAction`, `-InformationVariable`, `-OutBuffer`, `-OutVariable`, `-PipelineVariable`, `-ProgressAction`, `-Verbose`, `-WarningAction`, `-WarningVariable` (about_CommonParameters).

## INPUTS

None.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixContext`: Holds the state of one runspace: the servers it is connected to, by name, and the current one.
